bio_en: Tachat Terlemezian was born on 5 December 1888 in Aygestan, Van, and was educated at the Van orphanage-school under the patronage of Hambardzum Yeramian, his youth fired by Raffi's writings and the echoes of the 1904 Sasun uprising. Formed by Ishkhan, Aram and Koms, he and eleven other youths took the ARF oath on 14 February 1904. In 1908 he shot dead the traitor Davo, whose betrayal had exposed the party in Van, escaping in a zigzag toward the Armenian quarters. He later went via Constantinople to the United States, and was described as the last representative of the phalanx of avengers when he died in 1982.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Quote #32 ('The boom was heard and the traitor fell...') is his.
